Most submissive [Cobweb](/person/675),
The only change that I would suggest this time would be that for the word Evangelists you should substitute Gospels – as the Forms to which you refer rather symbolize the characteristics of the Gospels themselves than of their writers The [answers](/topic/104) will carry you all very deep and high.
[The Humble Bee](/person/81)[^2] will be delighted with [Kepler](/person/1850) as the stars are her peculiar line.

We shall have such beautiful stories of [Handel](/person/1851) that I much look forward to him, but I wonder if any one will take the new view of [Wallace](/person/1852)?
your faithful
Mother Goose


[^1]: Tiny 95mm x 54mm blue envelope addressed to ‘Miss Helmore/6 Cheyne Walk/Chelsea/SW’ postmarked Winchester 18 March 1861 and London 19 March 1861,
[^2]: (Frances) Emily Moberly (1844-1921) was a Gosling as Humble Bee from 1859-1868(?),
